name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish inventor and physicist who developed Atomic Layer Epitaxy (ALE) and Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD).

name: Riikka L. Puurunen
summary: Researcher at VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland and author of this historical essay.

name: Tampere
summary: City in Finland where Tuomo Suntola was born.

name: Finland
summary: Country where Tuomo Suntola was born and conducted his work.

name: Helsinki University of Technology
summary: University where Tuomo Suntola studied electrical engineering and completed his doctoral thesis.

name: VTT Semiconductor Laboratory
summary: Laboratory established in 1964 where Suntola worked on humidity sensors before moving to Instrumentarium.

name: Vaisala Oy
summary: Finnish company specializing in meteorological instrumentation that commissioned the humidity sensor project.

name: Instrumentarium Oy
summary: Company where Suntola established a research group and invented Atomic Layer Epitaxy in 1974.

name: Lohja Oy
summary: Building material company that acquired the ALE-EL project in 1978 and started pilot production.

name: Planar Inc.
summary: American competitor that acquired Lohja's EL business in 1990.

name: Beneq Oy
summary: Company that acquired Planar's EL plant in Olarinluoma in 2012.

name: Neste Oy
summary: National oil company that established Microchemistry Ltd. as a subsidiary in 1987.

name: Microchemistry Ltd.
summary: Company founded in 1987 to develop ALE-based solar panels and later commercialize ALE reactors.

name: ASM
summary: Dutch company that acquired Microchemistry in 1999.

name: Picosun Oy
summary: Company founded in 2004 by Sven Lindfors and Kustaa Poutiainen, where Suntola later joined as board member.

name: Thor Stubb
summary: Professor at HUT who supervised Suntola's doctoral thesis and assigned the humidity sensor challenge.

name: Jorma Antson
summary: Colleague of Suntola who completed the humidity sensor development and co-authored the first ALE patent.

name: Sven Lindfors
summary: Closest co-worker to Suntola in ALE reactor design since 1975 and co-founder of Picosun Oy.

name: Arto Pakkala
summary: Colleague who reacted to the successful ZnCl2/H2S process demonstration in 1978.

name: Atomic Layer Epitaxy
summary: Thin film growth technique invented by Tuomo Suntola in 1974 based on saturating gas-solid reactions.

name: Humicap 1 sensor
summary: Humidity sensor developed by Suntola and Antson by the end of 1973 based on thin polymer films.

name: European SEMI Award 2004
summary: Award honoring Suntola as a pioneer in Atomic Layer Deposition Techniques.
